author: gobernment
body:
As Teamspeak Developer, he has constantly abused his powers since the time he was promoted, until now. I am filing this complaint since it will be easier to shift through claims, and hopefully understand the weight of the situation. Many other players have experienced the same exact problems, some of which who have claimed they will no longer use TeamSpeak (and have not recently been seen).

Some of these claims are, from numerous people: (Mine are in italics)
- Claiming he is above staff and is "god"
- Making up rules randomly without backing
- Not properly following the punishment guidelines
- Contributing to verbal abuse in channels
- Not properly upholding punishments (having other players pointing it out before he acts)
- Claiming his friends can use voice modifiers, and nobody else is permitted
- Biasedly enforcing rules (not enforcing rule 1 for some people, then for others)
- Setting up other users in 'traps' for trouble

Ones in underline have evidence.

Here is an exerpt for the underlined recordings:
https://www.dropbox.com/s/t56zuqxg7b4ak9g/zachary.wav?dl=0

As well as this, I do understand that this user in question has not been trained, and he has been only given a ban guide which he has not yet followed. Please improve this TeamSpeak developer by training him, or demoting him. Thank you.
